def: to smoke, whether literal or figurative

words.word: how long wilt thou be angry

occurrences.text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.
O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
words: how long wilt thou be angry
